description: Generate strategic account plans with power mapping (one row per contact you name), whitespace analysis, competitive questions and an answer for each objection. Builds a 90-day plan from the contacts, products, threats and notes you give it; it does not look the account up.

account_notes.description: Any additional context about the account

current_arr.description: Current ARR with this account (0 for prospects)

current_products.description: Products/services they currently use from you

known_contacts.description: Known contacts and their roles, one per line or separated by semicolons, for example: Head of RevOps (champion); CFO. Each entry becomes one row, so put other notes in account_notes

your_sector.description: Optional: your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear.

name: account_plan_builder
title: Account Plan Builder
